name: Shibukawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shibukawa city emblem in white: a stylised swirl of curved strokes with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shibukawa, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 February 2006.

features.role: Shibukawa city emblem — a stylised swirl of curved strokes with a small disc
